items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 June 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 13 June 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure north of Scotland, with high pressure south of England gradually tracking northwards.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 this afternoon, veering northwest this evening, then decreasing 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate at first, soon becoming slight or moderate, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, becoming variable 2 to 4 tomorrow afternoon, settling east or 3 or 4 occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, falling smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
